comments.author: andrewballinger
comments.text:
Been thinking about this for several days and I think I know the problem.

Giving orders and getting results is a separate skill from writing code, and the majority of engineers are not cut out for management, of people OR AI assistants.

I think this alone explains the greater part of the gaps people are feeling when working with these tools.
